sections.text: Dollar index 101.67 (+1.2% in a month, +3.5% YTD). A stronger dollar makes US grain, oilseeds, cotton and meat dearer abroad. USD/BRL 5.034 (-1.5% in a month): little changed. USD/CNY 6.675 (-0.3%); USD/MXN 18.65 (+8.4%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

us_econ: Inflation: CPI 3.7% y/y (2026-09), core 2.6%; core 3-month annualized 3.4%; core PCE 3.0%. Jobs: payrolls +29k in 2026-09 (3-month average +51k), unemployment 4.2% (+0.1), wages 3.0% y/y. Growth: real GDP 2.2% annualized in 2026-Q2, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.79% (+0.91 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.35%, real 10-year 2.77%. Farm prices (PPI farm products) +1.5% y/y; food-at-home CPI +1.8% y/y. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,567 Bcf (week to 2026-10-09), +67 Bcf vs a 5-year average +91 for the week; -2 Bcf (-0.1%) vs the 5-year average, -145 vs last year. Crude stocks 412.5 mb (-3.1 mb on the week, -3.7% vs 5-yr avg); gasoline -3.0 mb, distillate +1.7 mb; refinery utilization 93.4%. 3-2-1 crack $51.97/bbl (ULSD $95.14, gasoline $30.38). For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
